About Me

I grew up farming.
Now I tell the story.

I am an Agri-Tech Market Intelligence Writer and Content Strategist based in Oman. I came here deliberately — to study how agritech innovations are applied in desert environments and to understand what it takes to bring those solutions back to Africa.

I grew up farming in Nigeria. Maize, cassava, tomatoes, yam, watermelon. I know what it means to plant without data, harvest without guidance and lose without explanation. That experience is not background. It is my superpower.

I bridge the world of the farmer who farms by instinct and prayer and the world of the researcher who studies the technology that could change everything. That bridge is what agritech founders need someone to walk across in writing.

I am also the author of The $130 Billion Blind Spot — a 2026 market intelligence report covering agritech solutions across five emerging markets.
